name: cdms
description: Curriculum Development & Management System (CDMS) — modular monolith

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cdms/contracts && npm run build -w @cdms/api && npm run build -w @cdms/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cdms/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
